findings.title: FORMS: 21 unlocks with no structure
findings.summary: No entry in FORMS requires another, and they have no tiers or categories: the order is decided by price alone.
findings.why: Structure (tiers, branches, mutually exclusive picks) is what makes an upgrade a decision. A flat price list makes it shopping.

strengths: ERAS escalates smoothly across 6 entries (minR, maxR, growthNeeded, mutationsToLeap).
Replay sources: randomness (119), procedural (1), best scores (126), seeded (39).
